summary: CCEP disclosed weekly share repurchases under its EUR 1 billion buyback program announced on 17 February 2026, executed on US and London venues. Purchases totaled 297,365 shares during August 17-21, 2026, at weighted average prices ranging from USD 105.86 to USD 108.00 (US) and GBP 78.43 to GBP 79.15 (London). Shares were bought from Goldman Sachs entities and will be cancelled. This is a routine issuer buyback disclosure, mapping to an issuer tender/capital return. Watch for program completion pace and remaining capacity; no premium, advisor, or board recommendation stated.
